experimental_design: fractionation of HeLa nuclear extract followed by TMT labeling

HeLa nuclear extract was fractionated into 11 fractions, and a few active fractions were identified. Each fraction was loaded on 10% SDS-PAGE gel and run a short time with little separation. The proteins were then in-gel digested and labeled with 11 different tandem mass tags (TMT)
